brand.name: Ahl Cairo
brand.welcome: Welcome to Egypt, your second home

home.heroTitle: Service worthy of you and your family
home.heroSubtitle: A VIP travel and concierge company for our guests from the Gulf. Luxury airport reception, chauffeured cars, and hotel and serviced apartment bookings held to the highest standards of privacy and security.
home.servicesSubtitle: Three services, one point of contact, in Arabic and English.
home.trustPrivacyBody: Absolute discretion for you and your family in every detail, with privacy glass on our cars.
home.trustBilingualBody: A team available day and night, with licensed bilingual drivers who also act as guides.
home.trustFamilyBody: An elite fleet of the newest luxury cars under continuous maintenance, and stays in the finest secure locations.
home.howStep1: Choose a service and your dates
home.howStep1Body: You only ever see what is genuinely free on those dates.
home.howStep2Body: You receive a reference number immediately.
home.howStep3Body: The office confirms by phone or WhatsApp and arranges payment.
home.ctaBody: The office replies in Arabic or English, whichever you prefer.

about.title: About Ahl Cairo
about.body: Ahl Cairo is a VIP travel and concierge company founded to give our guests from the Gulf an exceptional experience. We are proud of our years serving Gulf families and our understanding of what they need: privacy, security and comfort.
about.hours: The office answers WhatsApp messages throughout the day.
about.body2: Our coordinators and professional drivers combine competence, good taste and complete respect for our guests’ privacy. We treat every client as family, because Egypt is your second home.
about.why1: A team available for you day and night
about.why2: Absolute privacy for you and your family in every detail
about.why3: Licensed, professional bilingual drivers and guides
about.why4: The newest luxury cars, continuously maintained

testimonials.title: What our guests say
testimonials.subtitle: The trust of our Gulf guests is our greatest achievement
testimonials.q1: خدمة تستحق كل كلمة من الثناء. الاستقبال في المطار كان ممتاز والسائق محترم جداً. خصوصية تامة لعائلتي. شكراً أهل كايرو.
testimonials.q2: تعاملت معهم مرتين، المرة الثانية كانت أحسن من الأولى. الشقة في الزمالك كانت نظيفة وفخمة والخدمة على مدار الساعة. أنصح بهم بشدة.
testimonials.q3: خدمة الفاست تراك VIP وفّرت علينا وقت وجهد كبير. السيارة المرسيدس كانت نظيفة والسائق يعرف الطرق جيداً. خدمة فاخرة فعلاً.
